name: Lucas Kaiser
source:
Likes: Attention, messing with people, shopping
Dislikes: Unknown

Lucas is the kinda guy who's always looking for a good time. He has a knack for reading others and is quite the conversationalist. Unfortunately, he's also got a rottenly antagonistic sense of fun. If you're unlucky enough to catch his eye don't expect to get rid of him easily.

[From [url=https://gb-patch.tumblr.com/post/161101615426/there-he-is-mr-halloween-hair-himself-the-ninth]Tumblr[/url]]
